## Purpose 
Add additional plots for debugging purposes


## To-do
I feel like there are lots of ways to make this better. For example, we could also compare against the other leaderboard data for then single site example, to make this better match the global leaderboard plots.
It would also be cool to have bias plots for all of the partitioning plots, but it was easiest to do it for ERA5 for now.

I wonder if we should also move away from the DictWriter and use the NetCDF file also for single column runs to unify the way we make plots, but these feels like a lot of work within minimal payoff
